text:
anya: quick heads-up: dumping a proposal here. we should replace the wide route_metadata JSON used by console joins with a compact `route_identity` column (text) + a small jsonb `route_props` for everything else. goal: smaller indexes, faster joins for dashboards and quota lookups.

devin: sounds promising. what's the migration path to avoid breaking quota reads and dashboard joins?

anya: outline: (1) ingest dual-write: set route_identity and route_props in parallel, (2) add a read shim `route_identity_text(row)` used by join paths, (3) backfill historical rows into route_identity via rate-limited jobs, (4) after stable canary, convert queries to read solely from `route_identity` and drop the heavy index on route_metadata.

kevin: dual-write + shim is safe. flag: index growth during backfill is a big risk. we should create the new index concurrently and monitor space. also consider creating partial index for hot tenants first.

maria: UX note: during backfill some dashboards that aggregate by route will show transient duplicates because some rows will still reference the old blob key. need a banner and a short FAQ for support.

sre-bot: backfill-job-7 enqueued on cluster-eu-west-1. policy: 1000 rows/s per job.

devin: for quota code, recommend a tiny SQL shim so we don't have to touch dozens of callers. sample: `CREATE FUNCTION get_customer_id(r telemetry_row) RETURNS text AS $$ SELECT COALESCE(r.route_identity, r.route_metadata->>'customer_id'); $$ LANGUAGE sql;` then callsites stay the same.

kevin: +1. add a feature-flagged adapter switch so we can flip read preference at runtime. also add an automated rollback: if query-p99 increases by 15% for 5m, flip reads back to v1.

maria: who runs the heavy backfill? infra or platform? suggest infra run it with a `backfill.throttle` env var and produce progress metrics (rows_backfilled, current_rate, eta).

anya: infra will operate it; eng-platform sets thresholds for canary. I'll add the flag to the PR and a `/migration-status` endpoint we can use for dashboard banners.

sre-bot: canary cohort started: tenants=5%, start_ts=6226003000. watchlist: console_query_p99, ingest_cpu, index_write_iops, dashboard_error_rate.

devin: docs action: short note for product + SRE teams describing known inconsistency windows and expected timeline.

kevin: ops action: create an alert rule and a grafana panel to track index size and write amplification.

maria: support runbook: how to interpret banner, how to check migration status, how to escalate if a customer reports mismatched counts.

anya: action items: anya -> migration PR (dual-write + shim + partial index), kevin -> canary toggle + alerts, infra -> run backfill with throttle + expose metrics, devin -> docs + banner copy, maria -> support runbook. will circle back with PR link. thanks :rocket:
